g.text: py-app-sticker-terminal-automaat-storing-bsg-i1 | type sticker | trim 81.1 x 86.1 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 81.1 x 86.1 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 87.1 x 92.1 mm.
Variabelen: header-colour = #1A3580; text-storing = Storing?; phone-number = 085 - 401 16 47; text-automaatnummer = Automaatnummer; automaatnummer = BSG-i1

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has no die line. The sticker is drawn with all four corners rounded at the header radius (4.63 mm). To be confirmed by the printer.

Terminal fault sticker: navy header with the reverse logo, 'Storing?' and the phone number in black (Ubuntu), then 'Automaatnummer' with either a dashed 'plaats sticker hier' field (variant leeg) or a navy bar with the machine number (variant bsg-i1). The text colour in the source is pure black, the template uses PY-Zwart. Sheet

TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token
